title: Dana: "It's approved." creates no junk approver claim; the golden path still stages cleanly
description: Regression fixture for the founder's live record 2026-09-18 (scripts/rehearse/reports/founder-2026-09-18/95b9ad42-7798-40d0-918a-7187295f5fb0.diagnostics.json, deployed_commit shown in that file, current main at the time of the fix was 44958e6): the founder's own verbatim closing clause "It's approved." (LAW 4 -- reproduced byte for byte here) is a statement that the request IS approved, never a naming of WHO approved it. Pre-fix, `extractCuedNames`'s reversed approver cue "(NAME) approved" matched the sentence-initial capital of the contraction "It's" as if it were a one-word person name (src/extract/claims.ts's NAME pattern allows an apostrophe), creating a real approver STATED claim with junk value "its". `selectLiveCommitment` then legitimately picked this junk claim as a genuine commitment to challenge and issued "Can you restate the approver you gave me earlier?" -- a question the caller could never truthfully answer, since he never named anyone; he answered honestly ("I did not mention anyone.", verbatim, t=87973/102974) and the server re-issued the same question four times (78.4s, 83.5s, 97.6s, 110.4s) before he gave up and offered a name he never actually claimed, which then graded FAIL. Fixed in three places: (1) src/extract/claims.ts's NON_NAME_WORD_STOPLIST -- a closed-class function word (pronoun/contraction/demonstrative) is never a real name, so "It's approved" now extracts NO approver claim at all (test/extract.test.ts); (2) src/challenges.ts's selectLiveCommitment -- defense in depth, refuses any claim whose normalized value is empty; (3) src/challenges.ts's isAnswerShapedFor -- a truthful "I never said that" denial to a LIVE_COMMITMENT challenge now grades AMBIGUOUS immediately instead of looping forever (both (2) and (3) proven directly at the unit level in test/challenges.test.ts's own describe block for this defect, using hand-built claims so the grading fix is exercised independent of the extraction fix). This fixture proves fix (1) holds through the REAL end-to-end engine on the founder's own words: replaying his exact opener (plus a fixture-authored TRAP_FACT correction and the standard readback sequence, same shape as scenario-a-dana-legitimate.json) produces NO approver evidence card at all -- the junk claim never exists to be challenged -- and the call still reaches STAGE with every AssuranceChecklist item true, exactly like the unaffected golden path.
